volume-hdd-save-2.scope: Native HDD Volume Load, Volume Dump save to private720KB FDD

reset-v2-list.scope: Native machine soft reset at actual transaction boundary. Not a physical cable/power reset or host-catalog mutation.

reset-v2-switch.scope: Native machine soft reset at actual transaction boundary. Not a physical cable/power reset or host-catalog mutation.

reset-v2-ready.scope: Native machine soft reset at actual transaction boundary. Not a physical cable/power reset or host-catalog mutation.

checkpoint-D8.scope: Completed D8 before readiness. Three fixture-invalidating recalls, including changed private catalog, refuse stale handoff; explicit fresh catalog/selection loads new exact media. Not arbitrary mid-CDB replay.

physical_actions: Mouse left at verified Disk header
busy-save.scope: Physical browser-header/Mode attempts during native mounted IMG Save; exact saved data. This does not prove every native conflict or static ownership.

stereo32-cold-2.scope: Native 44.1kHz distinct L/R pair,32MiB HD2 browser cold Sample Load and native Loop/Smoothing stereo preview/release.

midi-voice-list-v2.limitation: Observed finite workload, not a worst-case native service-time proof.

mounted-delete-v2.scope: Native performance and related hierarchy Delete on browser-mounted writable10MiB HD2 IMG.

mounted-delete-cold.scope: Fresh process browser-mounts the deleted IMG and reaches native empty performance list/zero sample allocations.

native-lcd-cold-system.scope: Native LCD Save System exported image cold boot and explicit ISO index1 exact Load/playback; no external checkpoint or physical media claim

native-pages-current.scope: Native LCD all100 full32-byte catalog entries, 15 pages forward/back, last Next and Collections; no mount or hardware claim

native-lcd-save-system.acceptance: Actual exported System image is checked and cold-booted by native-lcd-cold-system; no separate Save-only result was emitted.

limitations: Finite workload, not worst-case service or physical latency.
Modulo RW38 idle adjustment is correct modulo 65536; outer elapsed accounting cannot recover whole timer wraps across this service.
Exact received note messages do not establish real-time audio timing under the stress.

resident_census.limitation: Named native snapshots; not universal indirect-alias or DMA proof.

from multi_gates_common import *
case=P/'runs/midi-voice-list-v2';obs=case/'runtime/bs1-observer'
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in (obs/'irq.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
sent=json.loads((obs/'voice-midi.json').read_text())
pending=None;start=None;end=None;pairs=[];minimum=65535
for r in rows:
    if r['kind']=='service-entry':
        assert pending is None;pending=r;start=end=None
    elif r['kind']=='service-clock-start':start=r
    elif r['kind']=='service-clock-end':end=r
    elif r['kind']=='service-exit':
        assert pending is not None and start is not None and end is not None
        delta=(end['tick']-start['tick'])&65535
        scratch=list(pending['scratch']);scratch[(0x38-0x1c)//2]=(scratch[(0x38-0x1c)//2]+delta)&65535
        assert scratch==r['scratch']
        for key in ['selectors','sp','caller']:assert pending[key]==r[key],key
        assert r['mask0']==r['mask1']==0 and r['psw']&0x200==0
        ticks=round((end['seconds']-start['seconds'])*1000000)
        assert abs(((ticks-delta+32768)&65535)-32768)<=2,(ticks,delta)
        pairs.append(dict(entry=pending,clock_start=start,clock_end=end,exit=r,modulo_ticks=delta,
            observed_elapsed_ticks=ticks,whole_wrap_ticks_not_in_modulo_delta=ticks-delta,
            service_seconds=r['seconds']-pending['seconds']))
        pending=None
    elif r['kind']=='stack-write':minimum=min(minimum,(r['sp']&(~r['mask']&65535))|(r['data']&r['mask']))
assert pending is None and pairs
rx=[r for r in rows if r['kind']=='midi-rx' and not r['after_command']]
assert [r['data']&255 for r in rx]==[0xf8]+sent['bytes']
assert all(r['in_service'] and not r['after_command'] for r in rx)
assert not any(r['kind']=='spc-write-in-service' for r in rows)
begin=next(r for r in rows if r['kind']=='list-start');complete=next(r for r in rows if r['kind']=='list-complete')
assert complete['status']==complete['transport']==0 and complete['length']==4000
worst=max(pairs,key=lambda p:p['service_seconds'])
report=dict(passed_data_context_and_completion=True,timing_gate_passed=False,service_pairs=len(pairs),
    midi_bytes=len(rx),all_midi_received_inside_service_before_D7_completion=True,
    exact_scratch_modulo_clock_selectors_caller_and_sp=True,no_spc_writes_in_service=True,
    observed_stack_minimum=minimum,command_seconds=complete['seconds']-begin['seconds'],
    longest_service=worst,multiple_wrap_service_calls=sum(p['observed_elapsed_ticks']>65535 for p in pairs),
    largest_service_seconds=worst['service_seconds'],sent=sent,
    limitations=['Finite workload, not worst-case service or physical latency.',
      'Modulo RW38 idle adjustment is correct modulo 65536; outer elapsed accounting cannot recover whole timer wraps across this service.',
      'Exact received note messages do not establish real-time audio timing under the stress.'])
(P/'midi-stress-analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k not in ['longest_service','sent']},indent=2))
print('Worst clock interval',worst['observed_elapsed_ticks'],'ticks; modulo',worst['modulo_ticks'],'missing',worst['whole_wrap_ticks_not_in_modulo_delta'])

class Inputs:
    def __init__(self,rt,work):self.rt=rt;self.work=work;self.states=[];self.inputs=[]
    def wait(self,seconds):
        end=self.rt.request('status')[0]['seconds']+seconds;deadline=time.monotonic()+600
        while self.rt.request('status')[0]['seconds']<end:
            assert time.monotonic()<deadline,'Native wait exceeded 600 wall seconds'
            time.sleep(.01)
    def button(self,port,name):
        self.inputs.append(dict(button=[port,name]))
        self.rt.request('button',port=port,name=name,down=True);self.wait(.2)
        self.rt.request('button',port=port,name=name,down=False);self.wait(.2)
    def click(self,x,y):
        self.inputs.append(dict(click=[x,y]))
        self.rt.request('pointer',x=x,y=y);self.wait(.3)
        self.button(':NATIVE_MOUSE_BUTTONS','Mouse Left');self.wait(.3)
    def snap(self,name):
        frames=self.rt.request('frames')[1]
        Image.frombytes('RGBA',(640,480),frames[0][6:]).save(self.work/(name+'.png'))
        ram=(self.rt.observation_folder/f'frame-{self.rt.snapshot_count:02}.ram').read_bytes()
        j=json.loads((self.rt.observation_folder/f'frame-{self.rt.snapshot_count:02}.json').read_text())
        mode,target,count,first,scroll=struct.unpack_from('<5H',ram,0x5be0)
        s=dict(name=name,screen=j['screen'],controller=j['controller'],cursor=j['cursor'],
            mode=mode,target=target,count=count,first=first,scroll=scroll,
            allocations=struct.unpack_from('<H',ram,0x84616)[0],drive=ram[0xa737d])
        b=json.loads((A/'build-linked.json').read_text());image=(A/'full.img').read_bytes()
        assert ram[0x4080:0x4080+b['code_bytes']]==image[0x8880:0x8880+b['code_bytes']],'Browser code overwritten'
        for span in json.loads((A/'full.json').read_text())['sds']:
            off=span['file']-0x4800
            assert ram[off:off+span['bytes']]==bytes.fromhex(span['data']),'SDS code overwritten'
        self.states.append(s);print(s,flush=True)
        (self.work/'states.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.states,indent=2))
        return ram,s
    def ops(self,row):
        self.click(118,4);self.wait(.5);self.click(50,60);self.wait(.5)
        self.click(50,20+row*8);self.wait(3)
    def perform(self):
        self.click(10,4);self.click(15,20);self.wait(3)
    def audio(self,note=60):
        self.rt.request('pause');self.rt.request('audio_capture',enabled=True)
        pcm,result=audition(self.rt,0,note)
        self.rt.request('audio_capture',enabled=False);self.rt.request('resume')
        return pcm,result
    def commands(self):
        return [json.loads(x) for x in (self.rt.observation_folder/'toolbox.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    def finish(self,result):
        result.update(firmware_sha256=sha(A/'full.img'),boot_rom_sha256=sha(A/'gb6.bin'),
            emulator_sha256=sha(ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe'),states=self.states,
            physical_inputs=self.inputs,commands=self.commands(),observed_code_preserved=True)
        (self.work/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')

"""Run existing native acceptance workflows with read-only BS1 observations."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path('D:\\S-760')
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import s760_runtime

class ObservedRuntime(s760_runtime.NativeRuntime):
    def _start(self,timeout):
        folder=self.config.state_dir.resolve()/'bs1-observer'
        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        wrapper=folder/'wrapper.lua'
        observer=folder/'observer.lua'
        shutil.copyfile(HERE/'observer.lua',observer)
        wrapper.write_text('if _G.im1_runtime_started then return end; _G.im1_runtime_started=true\n'+'dofile('+json.dumps((ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua').as_posix())+')\n'
                           +'dofile('+json.dumps(observer.as_posix())+')\n',encoding='utf-8')
        launch=subprocess.Popen
        def observed(command,**kwargs):
            command=list(command)
            command[command.index('-autoboot_script')+1]=str(wrapper)
            kwargs['env']['BS1_OBSERVER_DIR']=folder.as_posix()
            kwargs['env']['S760_TOOLBOX_IMAGE_ROOT']=str((HERE/'sd').resolve())
            return launch(command,**kwargs)
        self.observation_folder=folder
        self.snapshot_count=0
        with patch('s760_runtime.subprocess.Popen',side_effect=observed):
            super()._start(timeout)

    def request(self,operation,**kwargs):
        result=super().request(operation,**kwargs)
        if operation=='frames':
            self.snapshot_count+=1
            tag=f'frame-{self.snapshot_count:02}'
            temporary=self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.tmp'
            temporary.write_text(tag,encoding='ascii')
            # Lua may briefly hold the request file open on Windows.
            deadline=time.monotonic()+2
            while True:
                try:
                    temporary.replace(self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.txt');break
                except PermissionError:
                    if time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise
                    time.sleep(.01)
            deadline=time.monotonic()+10
            while not (self.observation_folder/(tag+'.json')).exists():
                if self.process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('Observer process stopped')
                if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Read-only snapshot timed out')
                time.sleep(.02)
        return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--workflow',choices=('stereo','scsi-save'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    workflow=ROOT/'scripts'/('verify_native_sampling_input.py' if args.workflow=='stereo' else 'verify_native_scsi_save.py')
    files=[Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',workflow,ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.py',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua',ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'S760224.IMG',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN']
    identity={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
    sys.argv=[str(workflow),'--state-dir',str(args.output.resolve())]
    if args.workflow=='stereo':
        sys.argv+=['--blank-disk',str(ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/media-verification-20261012-065549/formatted.img')]
    with patch.object(s760_runtime,'NativeRuntime',ObservedRuntime):
        runpy.run_path(str(workflow),run_name='__main__')
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in files), 'Input changed during observation'
    (args.output/'observer-identities.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path('D:\\S-760')
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import s760_runtime

class ObservedRuntime(s760_runtime.NativeRuntime):
    def _start(self,timeout):
        folder=self.config.state_dir.resolve()/'bs1-observer'
        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        wrapper=folder/'wrapper.lua'
        observer=folder/'observer.lua'
        shutil.copyfile(HERE/'observer.lua',observer)
        wrapper.write_text('dofile('+json.dumps((ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua').as_posix())+')\n'
                           +'dofile('+json.dumps(observer.as_posix())+')\n',encoding='utf-8')
        launch=subprocess.Popen
        def observed(command,**kwargs):
            command=list(command)
            command[command.index('-autoboot_script')+1]=str(wrapper)
            kwargs['env']['BS1_OBSERVER_DIR']=folder.as_posix()
            kwargs['env']['S760_TOOLBOX_IMAGE_ROOT']=str((HERE/'sd').resolve())
            return launch(command,**kwargs)
        self.observation_folder=folder
        self.snapshot_count=0
        with patch('s760_runtime.subprocess.Popen',side_effect=observed):
            super()._start(timeout)

    def request(self,operation,**kwargs):
        result=super().request(operation,**kwargs)
        if operation=='frames':
            self.snapshot_count+=1
            tag=f'frame-{self.snapshot_count:02}'
            temporary=self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.tmp'
            temporary.write_text(tag,encoding='ascii')
            # Lua may briefly hold the request file open on Windows.
            deadline=time.monotonic()+2
            while True:
                try:
                    temporary.replace(self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.txt');break
                except PermissionError:
                    if time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise
                    time.sleep(.01)
            deadline=time.monotonic()+10
            while not (self.observation_folder/(tag+'.json')).exists():
                if self.process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('Observer process stopped')
                if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Read-only snapshot timed out')
                time.sleep(.02)
        return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--workflow',choices=('stereo','scsi-save'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    workflow=ROOT/'scripts'/('verify_native_sampling_input.py' if args.workflow=='stereo' else 'verify_native_scsi_save.py')
    files=[Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',workflow,ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.py',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua',ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'S760224.IMG',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN']
    identity={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
    sys.argv=[str(workflow),'--state-dir',str(args.output.resolve())]
    if args.workflow=='stereo':
        sys.argv+=['--blank-disk',str(ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/media-verification-20261012-065549/formatted.img')]
    with patch.object(s760_runtime,'NativeRuntime',ObservedRuntime):
        runpy.run_path(str(workflow),run_name='__main__')
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in files), 'Input changed during observation'
    (args.output/'observer-identities.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')

"""Full JMD native Roland CD1 Scan/Load, exact allocations, playback and cold recall.

Original firmware/pointer/MIDI controls only; private full CD copy; no guest state
injection except normal checkpoint restore. Not SCSI Save or physical timing proof.
"""
import argparse,hashlib,json,mmap,shutil,struct,time
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import replace
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from s760_runtime import NativeRuntime,RuntimeConfig
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE_SHA='1e3e25be27366d9499927417cf9a8194cc66269bca263466ce576e26b8291618'
def digest(path):
    with path.open('rb') as f:return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
def source_samples(source):
    # Independent bounded FAT reader for the fingerprinted native fixture.
    # Reference: https://github.com/bmxcode/samplerdisc (Roland S770 MR25A).
    assert digest(source)==SOURCE_SHA
    result=[]
    with source.open('rb') as f:
        d=mmap.mmap(f.fileno(),0,access=mmap.ACCESS_READ)
        try:
            assert d[4:14]==b'S770 MR25A'
            for index in range(struct.unpack_from('<H',d,0x11c)[0]):
                e=d[1644*512+index*32:1644*512+(index+1)*32]
                if not e[:16].startswith(b'K4 :'):continue
                assert e[16]==0x44
                cluster,count=struct.unpack_from('<HH',e,28);parts=[];seen=set()
                for _ in range(count):
                    assert 2<=cluster<0xfff6 and cluster not in seen,'Invalid sample FAT chain'
                    seen.add(cluster);offset=5548*512+(cluster-2)*9216
                    assert offset+9216<=len(d)
                    parts.append(d[offset:offset+9216]);cluster=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,1028*512+cluster*2)[0]
                assert cluster>=0xfff6,'Sample FAT chain exceeds declared allocation'
                result.append((index,e[:16].decode('ascii').rstrip(),b''.join(parts)))
        finally:d.close()
    assert len(result)==79
    return result
def render(runtime,n):
    blocks=[]
    while n:
        count=min(n,8192);blocks.append(runtime.render_audio(count)[1]);n-=count
    return b''.join(blocks)

    runtime.request('midi',bytes=[0x90|channel,note,100]);pcm=render(runtime,65536)
    values=np.frombuffer(pcm,dtype='<f4');assert np.isfinite(values).all() and 0<np.max(np.abs(values))<1
    runtime.request('midi',bytes=[0x80|channel,note,0]);tail=render(runtime,132300)
    assert np.max(np.abs(np.frombuffer(tail,dtype='<f4')[-88200:]))==0,'Loaded note failed to release'
    return pcm,{'channel':channel+1,'note':note,'peak':float(np.max(np.abs(values))),'silent_release_frames':44100}

    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument('--state-dir',type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--image',type=Path,default=ROOT/'sample_cds/roland/JMD_S760_Freeware_CD.iso')
    args=parser.parse_args();base=args.state_dir.resolve();source=args.image.resolve()
    if base.exists() and any(base.iterdir()):parser.error('Use a fresh private state directory')
    samples=source_samples(source);state=base/'load';folder=state/'roms/SCSI';folder.mkdir(parents=True)
    target=folder/'CD10_2048.iso';shutil.copyfile(source,target)
    cfg=RuntimeConfig(ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN',ROOT/'roms/System/S760224.IMG',state,sound=False,throttle=False,wave_dump=base/'wave.bin')
    report={}
    with NativeRuntime(cfg) as runtime:
        def wait(seconds):
            end=runtime.request('status')[0]['seconds']+seconds;deadline=time.monotonic()+120

            runtime.request('button',port=':NATIVE_MOUSE_BUTTONS',name='Mouse Left',down=False);wait(.3)
        def screenshot(name):Image.frombytes('RGBA',(640,480),runtime.request('frames')[1][0][6:]).save(base/name)
        wait(25);click(118,5);click(80,22);wait(8);click(140,22);wait(2)
        click(96,78);runtime.request('button',port=':PANEL2',name='Panel F3',down=True);wait(.2)
        runtime.request('button',port=':PANEL2',name='Panel F3',down=False);wait(20);screenshot('scan.png')
        click(100,42);wait(8);screenshot('volumes.png');click(50,34);wait(1);click(76,98);wait(180);screenshot('loaded.png')
        click(10,5);click(15,22);wait(5);screenshot('perform.png')
        runtime.request('pause');runtime.save_checkpoint(base/'session.bin');runtime.request('audio_capture',enabled=True)
        rows=[]
